bio: Edward Joseph Ruscha IV is an American artist associated with the pop art movement. He has worked in the media of painting, printmaking, drawing, photography, and film. Ruscha lives and works in Culver City, California.

famous_artworks.title: Smells Like Back of Old Hot Radio (1976)

timeline.event: Moved to Los Angeles to study at Chouinard Art Institute
First solo exhibition at Ferus Gallery in Los Angeles
Created influential artist's books and word paintings
Began extensive photography projects documenting Los Angeles
Major retrospective exhibition at Museum of Modern Art
